confidence_levels.locally-confirmed: Reproduced locally across independent sessions or verified byte-for-byte against runtime code.
confidence_levels.publicly-confirmed: Implemented by at least two independent public parsers.
confidence_levels.parser-based: Present in a public parser but not yet validated field-by-field locally.
confidence_levels.inferred: Strong structural evidence exists, but the application meaning still needs a controlled test.
confidence_levels.observed: The opcode and shape are reproducibly visible after decryption; semantics are open.
confidence_levels.hypothesis: A candidate interpretation that requires another experiment.

opcodes.name: LOBBY_JOIN
opcodes.notes: Lobby join response in public parsers.

opcodes.name: LOBBY_WORLD_REDIRECT
opcodes.notes: Contains at least server ID, host, and port.

opcodes.name: CLIENT_MAP_PERIODIC_VALUE
opcodes.notes: A controlled map open-close-reopen test confirmed that this stream runs only while the map is open. After the close marker, one already-scheduled sample arrived 265 ms later, followed by a 17.251-second gap; transmission resumed 1.024 seconds after the reopen marker. Active samples arrive approximately every 1.05-1.10 seconds with an invariant u32 value of 1110. The exact map subsystem meaning of that value remains open.

fields.name: map_periodic_value
fields.status: observed; 1110 in both retained live bursts, exact meaning unknown

opcodes.name: CLIENT_TIME
opcodes.notes: A newly sampled client timestamp, not an exact echo of the preceding server tick.

opcodes.name: CLIENT_PERIODIC_TELEMETRY
opcodes.notes: The first three consecutive retained samples increase the u64 value by exactly 10,000 each time, consistent with a ten-second monotonic-millisecond report. The value is not a Unix timestamp and the final byte varies.

fields.name: monotonic_time_ms
fields.status: inferred; exact +10000 steps in consecutive retained samples

opcodes.name: CLIENT_STARTUP_FLOAT_51
opcodes.notes: A live world-entry validation emitted five samples at approximately one-second intervals with float values 2000, 2500, 3000, 3500, and 3800. The field layout is confirmed; its application meaning remains open.

opcodes.name: WORLD_PING
opcodes.notes: Listed as ping by public parsers; distinct from confirmed C2S CLIENT_TIME.

opcodes.name: CLIENT_RSA_HANDSHAKE
opcodes.notes: Clear packet that installs an ephemeral RSA-2048 public key with exponent 3.

opcodes.name: SERVER_RSA_HANDSHAKE
opcodes.notes: The 256-byte block decrypts as RSA-OAEP-SHA1 and yields the complete 214-byte RC4 key.

opcodes.name: CLIENT_SESSION_SETUP
opcodes.notes: First encrypted body in all six decoded sessions. The byte layout and Base64 token grammar are locally confirmed. The encoded token is copied from the NC Platform SDK authn_token response field, with -authnToken: supported as an alternate input; the identifier meanings and other value sources remain open. Raw values are excluded.

fields.name: encoded_token
fields.status: confirmed; decodes to stable_identifier ':' connection_identifier NUL

fields.name: setup_flags
fields.status: confirmed bitfield: bit 0 is an unknown caller flag; bit 1 means optional_value > 0

fields.name: optional_value
fields.status: confirmed builder input; application meaning unknown

opcodes.name: LOGIN_OR_SERVER_TRANSFER
opcodes.notes: Public parser and local context suggest login or server transfer. In two local sessions this was the sole inner frame of the first S2C LZ4 bundle and echoed the C2S 13 36 primary identifier near its tail. The complete response arrived about 1.7 seconds after 13 36, so it is not the client's source for that value.

fields.name: echoed_primary_identifier_length
fields.status: confirmed in two sessions; observed value 43

fields.name: echoed_primary_identifier
fields.status: confirmed byte-equal to preceding C2S 13 36 value

fields.name: trailing_fields
fields.status: stable structure in two sessions; semantics unknown

opcodes.name: GAME_SERVER_INFO
opcodes.notes: Game-server information in public parser mappings.

opcodes.name: CLIENT_MOVEMENT_UPDATE_VARIANT
opcodes.notes: Shares the same position, movement-heading, facing-heading, mode, and timestamp layout as 01 37, but occurs much less often and commonly follows movement-skill sequences. The compressed heading decodes as value * 360 / 65536 degrees; divergence from the float heading is consistent with movement direction differing from facing direction.

opcodes.name: CLIENT_MOVEMENT_UPDATE
opcodes.notes: High-frequency movement update. The 30-byte moving form uses flags 0x02 and carries movement_mode 0x01. A controlled capture added a 29-byte flags-0x00 stop/idle form without movement_mode. The compressed heading decodes as value * 360 / 65536 degrees; its occasional divergence from the float heading is consistent with strafing or backwards movement.

fields.name: optional_movement_mode
fields.status: 0x01 in the 30-byte flags-0x02 form; absent from the 29-byte flags-0x00 form

opcodes.name: CLIENT_AIRBORNE_TRANSITION
opcodes.notes: An isolated stationary jump emitted a 40-byte takeoff form with +1000 vertical velocity and a 41-byte near-apex form. Separate controlled actions used the 41-byte form for flight descent and manual wing exit. The marker distinguishes the observed transitions: 0x02 near the jump apex, 0x03 at the start of controlled descent, and 0x04 on manual wing exit.

fields.name: transition_flags
fields.status: observed; 0x14 at jump takeoff and 0x11 near the jump apex or on manual wing exit

fields.name: optional_marker
fields.status: present in 41-byte flags-0x11 forms; 0x02 near the jump apex, 0x03 at controlled flight descent, and 0x04 on manual wing exit

fields.name: velocity_xyz
fields.status: confirmed by controlled jump and descent trajectories

fields.name: movement_mode
fields.status: observed; 0x03 at takeoff and 0x01 near the apex

opcodes.name: CLIENT_AIRBORNE_MOVEMENT
opcodes.notes: Six samples at approximately 10 Hz described an isolated stationary jump, and a manual wing exit produced four more. A controlled flight-descent action added 13 samples whose Z velocity progressed from approximately -305 to -2744 while position Z fell by 2456 units. This is the airborne or falling movement stream shared by jumping, flight descent, and wing exit.

fields.name: velocity_xyz
fields.status: confirmed by controlled jump and flight-descent trajectories

opcodes.name: CLIENT_TIMESTAMP_MARKER_04
opcodes.notes: Timestamp-only family-37 marker observed near movement and skill transitions. Its exact application meaning and distinction from 05 37 remain open.

fields.name: client_unix_ms
fields.status: confirmed in every retained plaintext sample

opcodes.name: CLIENT_TIMESTAMP_MARKER_05
opcodes.notes: Timestamp-only family-37 marker observed near movement and skill transitions. Its exact application meaning and distinction from 04 37 remain open.

fields.name: client_unix_ms
fields.status: confirmed in every retained plaintext sample

opcodes.name: CLIENT_FLIGHT_TRANSITION
opcodes.notes: Controlled wing deployment, ascent, and forward-flight actions confirmed this transition form. In both the ascent and forward tests, its velocity triplet was byte-identical to the simultaneously emitted first 0B 37 update. The 41-byte flags-0x03 form adds marker 0x03 immediately before movement_mode; the 40-byte flags-0x02 form omits it.

fields.name: velocity_xyz
fields.status: confirmed by exact equality with the first 0B 37 velocity and subsequent position change

fields.name: optional_transition_marker
fields.status: 0x03 in the 41-byte form; absent from the 40-byte form

opcodes.name: CLIENT_FLIGHT_MOVEMENT
opcodes.notes: High-rate flight movement stream associated with 0A 37 transitions. Controlled ascent produced a Z velocity near +1187.68, while controlled forward flight produced 41 samples whose velocity integral matched the measured XYZ position change. Stationary hover emitted no 0B 37 samples. The stream therefore reports active flight motion rather than a periodic flight-state heartbeat.

fields.name: velocity_xyz
fields.status: confirmed by controlled ascent/forward actions and integrated position change

opcodes.name: CLIENT_MAP_PERIODIC_PULSE
opcodes.notes: A controlled map open-close-reopen test confirmed this opcode-only stream runs only while the map is open. One already-scheduled pulse arrived 484 ms after the close marker, followed by a 17.064-second gap; transmission resumed 1.056 seconds after the reopen marker. Its approximately 1.204-second cadence is independent of 00 91, excluding a one-for-one acknowledgement relationship.

opcodes.name: CLIENT_SPECIAL_MOVEMENT_0C_TRANSITION
opcodes.notes: Two packets in the special-movement capture bracketed a short ten-sample 0D 37 movement run after the controlled eight-jump marker. The four vector triplets form a continuous movement/control-point structure; their exact roles and in-game mode remain open.

opcodes.name: CLIENT_SPECIAL_MOVEMENT_0D_UPDATE
opcodes.notes: Ten position updates in the special-movement capture occurred between two 0C 37 transition packets. The layout is a flag-free position/heading/mode/time form. The exact in-game movement mode remains open.

opcodes.name: CLIENT_LANDING_BOUNDARY
opcodes.notes: A controlled flight-descent action ended with 10 37, four 11 37 updates, and 18 37. A second descent later in the same session reproduced the sequence. The 10 37 post-opcode payload is byte-identical to the simultaneous first 11 37 update, indicating a landing boundary; another explicitly marked landing test should promote the application meaning to locally confirmed.

opcodes.name: CLIENT_LANDING_MOVEMENT
opcodes.notes: Two descent sequences each produced exactly four movement updates after a 10 37 boundary and before an 18 37 action-position snapshot. The first update is byte-identical after the opcode to 10 37. Timing and position continuity identify this as a likely landing movement phase pending one explicitly marked landing-only test.

opcodes.name: CLIENT_SPECIAL_MOVEMENT_19_PREFIX
opcodes.notes: One timestamp-free position/vector packet immediately preceded the first retained 0A 37 / 0B 37 movement run. Another isolated capture is needed to establish whether it initiates that mode.

fields.name: position_xyz
fields.status: confirmed by continuity with the following movement run

opcodes.name: CLIENT_ACTION_POSITION
opcodes.notes: Position and heading snapshot that frequently appears immediately before 00 38 skill requests. It also terminated an isolated stationary jump at the original ground position, so it is not skill-specific.

opcodes.name: CLIENT_SKILL_REQUEST
opcodes.notes: All 16 distinct u32 values at offset 4 across 323 retained samples match published skill IDs. The request flags select a fixed 17-byte aim block, an optional one-byte marker, and zero, one, or two trailing float parameters.

opcodes.name: CLIENT_SKILL_TARGET_CONTEXT
opcodes.notes: Carries the active target entity immediately before targeted skill requests. A zero reference was observed when the following request was self-targeted or had no selected target. This is distinct from 33 38 target-selection changes.

opcodes.name: CLIENT_TARGET_SELECTION
opcodes.notes: Controlled target changes produced 33 38 with the newly selected entity ID. Clearing the target produced a zero entity reference. The compact varint explains both observed body lengths.

opcodes.name: CLIENT_SKILL_REQUEST_BEGIN
opcodes.notes: Opcode-only packet immediately preceding targeted 00 38 skill requests. Four controlled pairs bracketed Flame Arrow, Blaze, Bittercold Wind, and Firestorm. No captured pair exceeded 107 ms, supporting a protocol request boundary rather than raw key-down state; another dedicated hold test should confirm this.

opcodes.name: CLIENT_SKILL_REQUEST_END
opcodes.notes: Opcode-only packet immediately following the targeted skill request begun by 3A 38. In the controlled capture it arrived 67-107 ms after 3A 38; another dedicated hold test should confirm that the interval is independent of input duration.

opcodes.name: CLIENT_LOCATION_SKILL_REQUEST
opcodes.notes: The retained plaintext samples carry skill ID 15060150, independently catalogued as Hellfire, followed by a tagged target entity and world position. This appears to be the location-targeted skill-request form.

opcodes.name: CLIENT_LOCATION_SKILL_FOLLOWUP
opcodes.notes: A fixed 13-byte packet repeatedly follows 1A 38. Its u32 at offset 7 is skill variant 15060153, which is also enumerated by Aion2Flow's public skill-icon catalog and is numerically adjacent to Hellfire skill ID 15060150. The exact stage and field semantics need a controlled Hellfire-only capture.

opcodes.name: CLIENT_DODGE_REQUEST
opcodes.notes: Every retained packet carries skill 15000100 or its 15000101 variant; 15000100 is independently catalogued as Dodge. Multiple controlled actions reproduced the request immediately before a short 0F 37 movement run; the latest isolated action produced three movement samples.

opcodes.name: CLIENT_DODGE_MOVEMENT
opcodes.notes: Movement samples immediately following 0E 37 Dodge requests in multiple controlled captures. Separate actions produced two or three samples per request. The 40-byte form has an additional movement-mode byte immediately before the timestamp.

opcodes.name: CLIENT_STARTUP_SIGNAL
opcodes.notes: Opcode-only packet observed in both initial encrypted sequences; semantics are open.

opcodes.name: CLIENT_ZLIB_BLOB
opcodes.notes: Carries a zlib stream that expands to UTF-16LE JSON-like configuration content.

0737.notes: Absent from the fifth controlled session covering ordinary movement, jump, target selection, one location-targeted skill, and Dodge.

1337.notes: Absent from the fifth controlled session covering ordinary movement, jump, target selection, one location-targeted skill, and Dodge.

A1FF.notes: Not an outer LZ4 marker; compressed outer bodies require FF FF. A separate live validation showed an approximately 30-second cadence across both lengths. One sample merely coincided with wing deployment, while the cadence continued unchanged before and after the action.

1790.notes: The three retained plaintext samples were byte-identical.
